sentences.text:
DATE : 24.02.2020 P.C. :-
The applicant is seeking bail in the event of his arrest in connection with Crime No.181/19 registered with Purna Police Station, Dist.Parbhani for the offences punishable under Sections 328, 272, 273, 188, 120B of I.P.C. and under Section 26(2)(6), 27(2)(e), 30(2)(a), 59(6) of Food Safety and Standards Act, 2006.
2] After having heard both the sides, it transpires that a co-accused Mohammad Kalim Mohammad Yusuf Ansari has been granted anticipatory bail by this Court in Anticipatory Bail Application No.1533/2019 by order dated 11/12/2019.
Like that applicant, even role attributed to the applicant is similar.
It is only in the statement of co-accused that their names have surfaced.
In view of the reasoning given by this Court in that order dated 11/12/2019, even applicant is entitled to bail in the event of his arrest subject to the same terms and conditions.
4 ] Ad-interim relief granted by order dated 14/01/2020 stands confirmed with the same terms and conditions.
